question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_paid
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY total_paid DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN customer_totals ct ON p.customer_id = ct.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.payment_month,
        c.first_name,
        c.last_name,
        p.monthly_total,
        LAG(p.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_month) AS prev_month_total,
        LAG(p.payment_month) OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_month) AS prev_month
    FROM monthly_payments p
    INNER JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    first_name || ' ' || last_name AS customer_name,
    strftime('%Y-%m', payment_month) AS month,
    ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) AS month_over_month_diff
FROM with_lag
WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(month_over_month_diff) DESC
LIMIT 1;
